findings.location: Price text (e.g., '£51.77') and availability text (e.g., 'In stock') for each product card
findings.issue: The light green color used for the price text and stock status on a white background has insufficient visual contrast, falling well below the WCAG AA requirement of 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or moderate visual impairments will find it extremely difficult to read the prices and availability status of the items.
findings.recommendation: Change the green text color to a darker shade, such as #2e7d32 (contrast ratio > 4.5:1) to ensure WCAG AA compliance while maintaining the semantic color meaning.

findings.location: Product titles (e.g., 'A Light in the ...') under each book cover image
findings.issue: Product titles are aggressively truncated to a single line with an ellipsis, preventing users from seeing the full title of the books directly from the gallery grid.
findings.user_impact: Users must click through to the product page or hover to discover the complete book title, which slows down the browsing flow and decreases usability.
findings.recommendation: Allow product titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines with a fixed-height container (e.g., line-clamp: 2; height: 40px;) to show more descriptive titles while maintaining grid alignment.

findings.location: Left sidebar category navigation menu (under 'Books' heading)
findings.issue: The list items use browser-default bullet points (hollow circles) which are positioned extremely close to the text, causing a crowded layout and looking unstyled.
findings.user_impact: The crowded list hierarchy looks unpolished and reduces the visual scanning efficiency of the categories list.
findings.recommendation: Remove default list styling using 'list-style: none;', and introduce custom padding-left (e.g., 8px) with a subtle vertical line or hover background to define hierarchy cleanly.
